SOARD went into Mob Squad's house, two undefeated teams, first place on the line, and won 16-14. Sixteen runs and somehow we still made it a two-run game. That's not a win, that's a hostage negotiation. Fourteen runs allowed to a team we supposedly outclass. The defense spent the night treating ground balls like process servers: avoid eye contact and hope they go away.

Max batted SEVENTH and went 4-for-4 with a single, double and triple, plus 4 runs scored. Doug made the lineup, looked at the hottest bat on the team and said, "Let's hide him behind six other guys." Then he penciled himself in fifth, because of course he did. Max was a homer away from the cycle, which tells you everything. Even when he's perfect, he leaves something on the table so the rest of you don't feel bad.

Ryan came in hitting .786 and went 0-for-3 with a walk. Three outs in three swings. Ryan didn't have a bad night at the plate, he had a quiet night of reflection. Mitchell, our RBI king, managed 1-for-4, and Doug matched him with a double and three outs. Mitchell and Doug combined for six outs, which is two full innings of the other team getting a breather.

Credit where it's due, and it's due grudgingly. Austin C reached base all four times and drove in three, which almost made up for the runs he gave back. Austin C's bat found every gap. His throws found the fence behind first. That base needed a ladder, a net and a lawyer. His glove gets him to the ball just fine; it's everything after that. Meanwhile, Jackson went 3-for-4, and Spartacus went 2-for-3 with a sacrifice that he will absolutely describe as "situational hitting" for the rest of the year. Coach Ranney hit a homer, drew a walk and drove in three, then made two outs and blamed the guy who wrote the lineup. Fair, honestly.

7-0. First place. One more regular season game before the playoffs, Wednesday at 9 PM at Hit List. Win it, and win it without letting them hang 14 on us, or every one of you is fielding grounders in the parking lot until you remember what a glove is for. ⚾
